description: One entry per distinct PAGE SHAPE. Every node is a structured object so `required`/`repeatable`/`variant` are machine-enforceable rather than implicit conventions. Every real route maps to exactly one template.

home.name: Homepage
home.surface: mixed (dark hero + orbit, then light sections)
home.description: Unique page shape. 7 body sections, in a fixed order, none optional and none repeatable. Three further CMS sections on this page carry hideSection:true and are DELIBERATELY unbuilt — they must not be recreated.
deliberatelyUnbuilt: 3 homepage CMS sections carry hideSection:true (CLONE_SPEC §4.8) and emit zero DOM. Intentional scope reduction — do NOT recreate them.

industry-page.name: Industry page (CMS pageBuilder)
industry-page.surface: light with one dark accordion section
industry-page.description: ONE template, six content sets, TWO real compositions. See `compositionVariance` for the evidence and the decision.

nodes.note: slot 1b — /shipping ONLY. Absent from the other five routes’ CMS sections[] array entirely, not merely hidden.
slot 2 — /shipping ONLY. The slot EXISTS on all six routes but carries hideSection:true on five, and a hidden section emits zero DOM.

compositionVariance.decision: ONE template with two optional, route-restricted nodes — NOT a separate /shipping template.
compositionVariance.method: MASTER-GUIDE §3.22. Rather than trusting the grouping or the prose, a first-party classifier was written that imports the real src/data/industries.js module and reproduces src/components/IndustryPage.jsx’s own slot logic verbatim, then run against all six routes. Output recorded in extraction/measured-values.json#routeComposition.classifierOutput.
whyOneTemplate: The 4-node sequence is a strict ORDERED SUBSEQUENCE of the 6-node one, at the same relative positions. No node order, adjacency or position rule differs between the two — only presence does. That is optionality within one shape, not a second shape.

The CMS evidence agrees: all six routes are a single Sanity `pageBuilder` document type. The featureDetail slot exists in all six sections[] arrays and is hidden on five (hideSection:true). A hidden slot is the CMS’s own expression of an optional node.

A second template would duplicate 4 of 6 node contracts verbatim and add a second route-mapping surface to keep in sync, buying nothing: the shared featureAccordion and logoShowcase sections measure pixel-identical across all six routes.
compositionVariance.riskClosed: The obvious risk of the optional model is that a generated PageSpec could claim the extra slots on, say, /chemicals. That is closed three ways: (1) both section contracts carry `constraints.routeAllowlist: ["/shipping"]`; (2) schema/semantic_validate.py enforces the allowlist against the PageSpec’s own `route` field; (3) compatibility/graph.json rule INDUSTRY_OPTIONAL_SLOTS_SHIPPING_ONLY is severity "error". An adversarial case proves it rejects /chemicals + industry.feature-detail AND that the real /shipping spec still passes.

otherPerRouteDifferences.hero asset kind: /shipping = motion.rive-scene; the other five = illustration.industry-masthead. Modelled as the `hero-rive` / `hero-static` variants of industry.nav-masthead, NOT as a template split.
otherPerRouteDifferences./chemicals: differs from the other four static-hero routes by EXACTLY ONE token: industry.icon-slider background is `dustToWhite` instead of `white`. Modelled as the `bg-dust-to-white` variant. Not a shape difference.

deliberatelyUnbuilt: slot 4 `customerStoriesSlider` carries hideSection:true on ALL SIX routes.
slot 6 has `blocks: null` and emits no section at all.
All of the above are intentional scope reductions. Do NOT recreate them.

platform.name: Platform
platform.surface: light, with a black->white transition inside stacked-panels
platform.description: Unique page shape with 3 block types that exist nowhere else on the site. Exactly 3 wrapper slots: no hideSection:true slot and no empty blocks:null slot.
knownUpstreamDefects: `#integrations` is DELIBERATELY absent from this route — the footer link `/platform#integrations` is a dead anchor on the original too.

security.name: Security
security.description: 3 pageBuilder sections, all rendered, no hidden slots. Despite sharing a <title> with /platform (a CMS copy-paste mistake confirmed by recon), this is an UNRELATED document with zero overlap in block types. It also has no in-page anchors — none of its sections carries a sectionId.

about.name: About
about.surface: dark (flat #0F0C0B, not one gradient on the page)
about.description: 8 CMS pageBuilder slots, 6 rendered. THERE IS NO HERO: slot 0 (`arcMasthead`) is hideSection:true, so the page opens straight into the statementShowcase under pt-18 md:pt-24 lg:pt-40. Both hidden slots emit zero DOM; main > section is 6 at all four viewports.
deliberatelyUnbuilt: slot 0 `arcMasthead` — hideSection:true. This is why the template has no hero; it is intentional, not a gap.
slot 6 `contentSlider` — hideSection:true. No carousel, and therefore no Embla anywhere on this page.

legal.name: Legal document
legal.description: ONE template, two routes. Per CLONE_SPEC_LEGAL §0.1 the two routes are byte-for-byte the same wrapper markup; only the title, the "Last updated" line and the block array differ. Verified by the classifier: both routes resolve to the identical single-node sequence.
legal.contentGate: legal.prose-blocks requires `requiresOperatorSuppliedText: true`. The real text is another organisation’s legal instrument; the structure is reusable, the text is not.

not-found.name: 404 catch-all
not-found.description: The react-router catch-all. HONEST EVIDENCE GAP: the real component is an explicit stub ("STUB — awaiting recon measurements"). Recon never visited the original’s 404 route. This template exists so route coverage is 1:1; it must not be read as measured.

deliberatelyAbsent./industries: does NOT exist and must not be created — it 404s on the original.
